page.description: View account balances and per-key usage separately
notice.budget: Local budget and official snapshots are labeled separately · account-shared quota is counted once
login.subtitle: Sign in to the quota dashboard
login.memoryNote: The token is kept only in this page's memory. Reloading or closing the page requires signing in again.
login.invalidToken: Invalid admin token. Please try again.
login.tooMany: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again later.
error.loadFailed: Refresh failed; showing the last data. {error}
error.traceReadFailed: Unable to read the trace. Please retry.
error.configUpdated: Configuration changed. Close and reopen the editor, review the latest content, then save again.
error.saveFailed: Save failed. Check the fields, duplicate keys, and whether the quota needs manual reconciliation.
error.httpsRequired: HTTPS, a loopback address, or valid admin permission is required.
error.connectionInterrupted: The connection was interrupted. Refresh to confirm the result before retrying.
error.alertUpdated: The alert state changed or the request failed. Check the latest content.
error.connectionRefresh: Connection failed. Refresh and try again.
sync.result: Official balance sync: {ok} account(s) succeeded, {failed} failed, {limited} cooling down, {skipped} unsupported or missing credentials.
note.poolShared: The current balance belongs to the quota pool. Multiple keys under the same account share it. The month filter only affects call statistics.
note.pendingReserved: Reserved budget for pending requests is included in consumption.
note.legacyMode: Legacy single-key mode: historical usage cannot be attributed to individual keys. Per-key statistics start after multi-key is configured.
note.updatedAt: Updated {time} · Statistics month {month} (UTC) · Current window is an estimate
scheduler.external: Automatic balance sync is managed by the MCP service · every {seconds} seconds
scheduler.running: Background balance sync is running · every {seconds} seconds
scheduler.notStarted: Background balance monitoring has not started
scheduler.refreshNote: Page refreshes every 30 seconds while visible
scheduler.lastError: Background refresh is temporarily failing; the last budget state is preserved
scheduling.explanation.priority: Try keys in priority order (existing behavior).
scheduling.explanation.balanced: Prefer the account with the higher remaining free-quota ratio to spread consumption.
scheduling.explanation.expiry: Prefer confirmed free quota that resets soonest to reduce waste.
scheduling.explanation.preferred_account: Prefer keys from the specified account, then fall back to other keys.
cache.enabled: Response cache: {entries} entries · {hits} hits · search TTL {searchTtl}s · fetch TTL {fetchTtl}s
cache.freshnessNote: Freshness-sensitive queries bypass the cache automatically
call.heading: Per-key calls
call.empty: No calls in the selected month
call.note: Shows up to the 100 most recent calls in the selected month. Uncertain means budget is held pending reconciliation.
balance.ceiling: Total is a ceiling only; free budget is confirmed locally
balance.empty: No official balance snapshots in the selected month
balance.note: Keeps the 100 most recent successful queries in the selected month. Failed queries keep the previous snapshot and do not reset the balance to full.
keymgmt.pool.intro: Enter the current free budget from the provider account console. After confirmation, existing consumption is retained as the initial usage.
keymgmt.pool.youNote: You.com uses a USD budget. Signup credits should be confirmed against the actual grant and current usage; they are not automatically renewed monthly. Basic search reserves 0.005 USD per call.
keymgmt.pool.used: Quota already used in the current window
keymgmt.pool.confirmed: I confirm this is free quota and that consumption from legacy services and other clients is included
keymgmt.account.label: Account
keymgmt.sharedPool: Keys under this account share the existing quota pool and do not add another budget.
keymgmt.jinaNote: Each Jina key uses an independent wallet. Reader is supported; reranking is not yet enabled. When replacing a key with confirmed quota, create a new independent wallet instead of reusing the old budget.
keymgmt.replaceKey: Replace API key (leave empty to keep)
keymgmt.secureWarning: Adding or replacing credentials requires HTTPS or a loopback address.
keymgmt.newAccountNote: New accounts start with no available budget. They join routing only after the quota is verified and confirmed.
keymgmt.encryptedNote: Credentials are encrypted on the server and are never shown again after saving.
keymgmt.disabled: Secure credential storage is not enabled. You can only view keys for now. See the project documentation for setup.
keymgmt.revision: Config revision {revision} · Disabling and replacing keys preserves historical usage
keymgmt.empty: No accounts yet. Add the first key to get started.
alert.note: A persistent state does not create repeated alerts. Dismissing hides this occurrence only and does not lift budget limits; if the issue recurs after recovery, it will be shown again.
alert.unsupported_unit.title: You.com budget unit needs review
alert.unsupported_unit.message: {name} uses a USD budget for keyed search; legacy request-based configuration stays blocked and is not converted or reset automatically.
alert.unsupported_cost.title: Jina reranking is not enabled
alert.unsupported_cost.message: {name} supports bounded Reader; the reranking cost ceiling is still unverified.
alert.wallet_mismatch.title: Jina wallet ownership needs adjustment
alert.wallet_mismatch.message: {name} has multiple keys; create an independent wallet per key instead of sharing unverified budget.
alert.stale_balance.title: Official balance snapshot expired
alert.stale_balance.message: Restricted budget for {name} is paused until the next successful sync.
alert.unverified_balance.title: Free source of official balance is unverified
alert.unverified_balance.message: The total balance for {name} cannot be treated as available free quota.
alert.sync_failure.title: Official balance sync keeps failing
alert.sync_failure.message: {name} has failed {failures} consecutive times; the previous snapshot is kept.
alert.missing_key.title: Key has no credential
alert.invalid_key.title: Key validation failed; disabled
alert.invalid_key.message: Check or replace the credential for {name}.
alert.rate_limit.title: Key is cooling down after rate limiting
alert.rate_limit.message: {name} will rejoin routing automatically after the cooldown.
alert.unconfirmed_pool.title: Account free budget is not confirmed
alert.unconfirmed_pool.message: Verify the free total, initial usage, and billing window for {name}.
alert.budget_unavailable.title: Insufficient confirmed free budget
alert.budget_unavailable.message: {name} has insufficient budget or conservatively reserved calls; check the real balance and pending calls.
alert.low_balance.title: Account free budget is running low
alert.forecast_depletion.title: Budget may run out early at the current pace
alert.forecast_depletion.message: Based on the last 7 days of settled local usage, {name} is estimated to last about {estimated_days} days; this is only an estimate.
trace.heading: Request traces
trace.description: Searches and fetches from the same research session are grouped into one trace. Queries, URLs, credentials, and raw upstream errors are not recorded.
trace.empty: No traces in the selected month; old records are not backfilled with routing decisions.
trace.dropped: The event limit of 500 was reached; {count} more events were omitted.
trace.noReservation: No multi-key budget reservation. Self-hosted or legacy calls do not imply a cost.
trace.completionNote: Completed means the flow returned; individual providers may still fail. In-flight can also mean the process was interrupted; the ledger is the source of truth for budget.
trace.reason.official_budget_unavailable: Official free budget insufficient, expired, or unverified
trace.reason.cost_bound_exceeded: Actual cost exceeded reservation; pool blocked
trace.reason.policy_limit: Provider limit for the current mode exceeded
trace.reason.local_free: Local keyword reranking; no provider tokens spent
trace.reason.site_filter: Filtered results that did not meet site constraints
trace.reason.preferred_account_missing: Preferred account missing; fell back to priority
remaining.syncFailedCeiling: Sync failed; keeping the previous total ceiling
remaining.totalCeiling: Official total is a ceiling · free source not separated; budget confirmed locally
remaining.syncFailed: Sync failed; keeping the previous snapshot
remaining.forecast: Local pace over 7 days: about {days} days
remaining.poolBudgetPaused: Free source not separated; budget paused
theme.label: Theme
